pkgmetadata.longdescription: Swayimg is a lightweight image viewer for Wayland compositors and DRM consoles. It can show images inside a "overlay" window on Sway, has a thumbnail gallery mode, slideshow, and is fully configurable with Lua scripts.

use.flag: Enable DRM (Direct Rendering Manager) console output
Enable EXR image format support via media-libs/openexr
Enable JPEG 2000 image format support via media-libs/openjpeg
Enable raw image format support via media-libs/libraw
Enable Sixel image format support via media-libs/libsixel
